title: Student Life & Administration
description: Ward office registration (Kuyakusho), commuter passes (Teikiken), convenience store phrases, and dormitory life.
reviewedBy: Kazi Sakib (Founding Mentor, University of Tokyo)

items.explanation: Municipal ward/city office where students register residence within 14 days and enroll in National Health Insurance (Kokumin Kenko Hoken).
Official Residence Card issued to foreign nationals living in Japan for mid-to-long term.
Discounted student commuter rail pass between residence station and campus station.

items.prompt: 袋は要りません (Fukuro wa irimasen)
items.explanation: Common phrase used at convenience stores (Konbini) and supermarkets: 'I don't need a bag'.
options: I don't need a plastic bag.
items.correctAnswer: I don't need a plastic bag.

items.prompt: 国民健康保険 (Kokumin Kenkou Hoken)
items.soundText: こくみんけんこうほけん
items.explanation: National Health Insurance covering 70% of medical costs for students residing in Japan.
